audit.compliance_notes: [engine: deepseek-r1] Unit entitlement is 1.42% per Schedule II, paragraph 4. Voting threshold for extraordinary resolutions is 75% per Schedule III; 1.42% is insufficient to meet this threshold alone. Statutory vulnerabilities include registration risks under Cap. 229 §31, fire safety non-compliance under Building Code §4.3, and missing data protection basis under Data Protection Act 2019 Section 6. Pet clause requires landlord consent not to be unreasonably withheld. Section 20 consultation may apply for major works. Beneficial ownership disclosure required under Companies Act 1981, Cap. 308.
